title: Event Envelope
description: Every write to the object graph is an immutable event, never an in-place overwrite (ISO 9001 §7.5 document control + event-sourced engineering discipline, one mechanism serving both — Core Model §07). Current entity state is a fold over its event stream. Events are hash-chained for tamper-evidence (prev_hash/hash). This envelope is LOCKED for Phase 1.

event_id.description: ULID-style monotonic event id (evt_ prefix). Sortable by creation time.

ts.description: UTC timestamp the event was recorded.

entity_type.description: Which entity kind this event mutates.

entity_id.description: Stable id of the entity (e.g. process apqc_code CO.3.2.7, or gr.CO.3.2.7). Constant across all versions.

op.description: create = first version; update = new version supersedes prior; deprecate = retire without deleting (records are never hard-deleted); restore = reinstate a deprecated entity as a new version.

from_version.description: The version this event supersedes. null only for op=create.

to_version.description: The version this event produces. Monotonic per entity_id.

actor.description: Who caused the write. An agent action cites the guardrail version it acted under here or in the payload.

id.description: role.* for a human, agent binding id for an agent, or 'system' for a migration/job.

reason.description: Free-text change note (ISO 9001 §7.5 review/approval trail). Not served to agents.

payload.description: The full entity body at to_version, validating against that entity_type's schema. Stored whole (snapshot-per-event) so any historical version is reconstructable without replaying deltas.

prev_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the previous event in this log (64 zeros for the first event). Links the chain — any deletion, reorder, or insertion breaks it (verify_log). ISO 9001 §7.5 tamper-evidence.

hash.description: SHA-256 over this event's canonical form excluding `hash` itself but including `prev_hash`. Recomputed on verification; a mismatch means the event was modified.
